newsitem.title: USA: Ericsson launches ads for new telephone.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson launches ads for new telephone.

text.p: Ericsson Inc said Tuesday that it launched its new lifestyle-driven advertising campaign for the recently introduced ultra-compact AF 738 personal telephone.
In a release Tuesday the company said the campaign will appear in full-color, full-page ads in major national dailies and full-page black and white ads in regional dailies.
The company said the campaign will also be featured on billboards in Los Angeles, Dallas, Atlanta, New York and Chicago.
The AF 738 will be sold in the U.S. and around the world wherever AMPS systems operate, including Canada, Latin America, Asia Pacific and Australia, Ericsson said.
